accounting.rationale: Defines the term reference for an appearance of a data object designator in a value-requiring context; the definedness permission and variable rules are accounted in 9.2.
The term is limited to data object designators.
The context must require the designator's value.
This supplies terminology used by later requirements, not a separate executable effect.

requirements.title: A designator is one of the seven designator forms
requirements.definition: A designator is exactly one of: object-name, array-element, array-section, coindexed-named-object, complex-part-designator, structure-component, or substring. The detailed formation and semantic restrictions for those alternatives are supplied by their owning subclauses; this rule does not define array, component, coindexing, complex-part, or substring semantics itself.

pending.object-name-alternative: PENDING complete source with an ordinary local INTEGER scalar used in a value context after assignment to literal 11. The oracle is the printed literal 11; non-vacuous execution changes the assignment literal and observes the changed value, while object-name formation remains owned by 6.2.2/9.2.
pending.array-element-alternative: PENDING complete source with a rank-one INTEGER array, defined elements 11 and 22, and a reference to a(2). The oracle is literal 22 and an executed branch proving the element, not the whole array, was selected; element syntax/rank/bounds remain 9.5.3.1 dependencies.
pending.array-section-alternative: PENDING complete source with INTEGER array values [11,22,33] and a whole-array assignment or intrinsic inquiry using a(1:3:2). The independent oracle is shape [2] plus literals [11,33], making the section non-vacuous without address or storage-layout assumptions; section rules remain owned by 9.5.3.1-.3.
pending.coindexed-named-object-alternative: PENDING source plan for a scalar coarray designator x[1] in a context that otherwise satisfies coarray declarations and image-selector requirements. The oracle would be a defined literal target value on a qualified multi-image configuration; if such execution support is absent the facet remains pending, not replaced by a local variable test.
pending.complex-part-designator-alternative: PENDING complete source with a defined COMPLEX variable z=(3.0,4.0) and references z%RE and z%IM. The oracle is the independent literals 3.0 and 4.0 after checking the path executed; complex-part semantics and type/kind/shape remain 9.4.4 dependencies.
pending.structure-component-alternative: PENDING complete source defining a simple derived type with INTEGER component age, assigning p%age=37, and referencing p%age. The oracle is literal 37 with a mutation of the component value; component formation and base-object rules remain 7.5 and 9.4.2 dependencies.
pending.substring-alternative: PENDING complete source with CHARACTER(5) variable c='abcde' and reference c(2:4). The oracle is literal 'bcd' and reached comparison; substring bounds, defaults and character type are 9.4.1 dependencies.

requirements.oracle: Source-qualified paired plans and positive-control admissions, with any future executable observation delegated to the owning semantic requirement. A literal expected value or fixed inquiry result is stated only where the future program first establishes definedness and execution of the relevant path.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This catalogue records source requirements and plans only. It does not approve a Fortran fixture, run a processor, create coverage, or transfer ownership from the cited subclauses. Any later reuse must re-check all prerequisites, repairs, modes and overlapping constraints.

review_rationale: Independent source review in doc/source_audits/batch_087.json reads both original 9.1 units and their ten fine units, verifies the census hashes and all502 global grammar heads, and confirms that R901 lists exactly seven designator alternatives whose definitions remain owned by 9.4.x and 9.5.x rather than duplicated here. Paragraph p1 stays definition-only: it names the reference concept for a data object designator in a value-requiring context and imposes no separate diagnostic duty. All seven facets remain pending source plans; no case, execution, oracle or fixture approval is created.
